_comment_claudeArgs: REQUIRED and explicit. There is deliberately no default: the previous build defaulted a missing claudeArgs to --dangerously-skip-permissions, which silently bypassed the host's permission setup. If this host genuinely needs a permission-bypass flag, add it here AND set acknowledgeDangerousClaudeArgs to true, so the decision is recorded and reviewable.
_comment_promptDelivery: stdin is the ONLY accepted value, and the default. argv delivery was removed: it put the complete task on the child's command line at process-creation time, so the child could read and begin executing it before the durable child-identity handoff gate had committed - and no later abort can prove it had not. With stdin the prompt IS the task and it is written only after the identity record and the lock heartbeat are durable.
